name: Sippet Pudding
description: Historical recipe from The Virginia Housewife; Or, Methodical Cook (1824). Source method; not modernized or kitchen-tested.

instructions.text: Cut a loaf of bread as thin as possible
Put a layer of it in the bottom of a deep dish
Strew on some slices of marrow or butter, with a handful of currants or stoned raisins
Do this till the dish is full, let the currants or raisins be at the top
Beat four eggs, mix with them a quart of milk that has been boiled a little and become cold, a quarter of a pound of sugar, and a grated nutmeg
Pour it in, and bake it in a moderate oven

source.author: Mary Randolph
source.originalInstructions:
1. Cut a loaf of bread as thin as possible
2. Put a layer of it in the bottom of a deep dish
3. Strew on some slices of marrow or butter, with a handful of currants or stoned raisins
4. Do this till the dish is full, let the currants or raisins be at the top
5. Beat four eggs, mix with them a quart of milk that has been boiled a little and become cold, a quarter of a pound of sugar, and a grated nutmeg
6. Pour it in, and bake it in a moderate oven
7. Eat it with wine sauce
